meta.title: Referral Rewards — Earn $25 Per Referral | AWS OVERSEAS impex
meta.description: Refer someone to AWS OVERSEAS impex. When they ship, buy, or book any service, you earn $25 — paid straight to your wallet. No limit on how many times you can earn.

hero.title: Send a shipment their way. We'll send $25 your way.
hero.subtitle: Every person you bring to AWS OVERSEAS impex who completes a shipment, purchase, or booking puts $25 in your wallet. Simple as that — no tiers, no caps, no waiting.

howItWorks.title: How the payout works
howItWorks.description: Three steps between sharing your code and seeing $25 land in your wallet.

steps.title: Share your code
steps.description: Every AWS OVERSEAS impex account has a unique referral code. Send it to anyone shipping cargo, importing goods, or booking freight services.

steps.title: They complete an order
steps.description: A shipment, a product order, or any paid service booked under your code — it doesn't have to be a shipment specifically, and it isn't limited to their first one.

steps.title: $25 hits your wallet
steps.description: Once their order is confirmed and paid, we credit your AWS OVERSEAS impex wallet automatically. Track it from your referrals dashboard.

items.title: Any paid order qualifies
items.description: A freight shipment, a marketplace product, or a booked service — if money changes hands, it counts toward your $25.

items.title: Every shipment pays out
items.description: You earn $25 each time someone you referred completes a shipment — not just their first. Refer once, get paid for every order after.

items.title: No cap on referrals
items.description: Refer 1 person or 100 — every one of them that converts pays out $25. There's no monthly limit.

items.title: Paid to your wallet
items.description: Rewards land in your AWS OVERSEAS impex wallet, usable toward future shipments.

becomePartner.title: Become a Partner
becomePartner.description: AWS OVERSEAS impex invites individuals, agencies, and companies across every state in India, as well as international markets, to join us as trade partners and associates.

International partners and agents representing overseas markets
Freight forwarders, logistics companies, and trade consultants

whatsIncluded.title: What association with us includes
items: Access to our sourcing, shipping, and documentation network
Attractive commission on business generated through your referrals

cta.title: Your code is already waiting in your account
cta.description: Sign in to grab your referral code and start sharing — it takes less than a minute.

items.question: How much do I earn per referral?
items.answer: $25 for every person you refer who completes a paid shipment, product purchase, or service booking with AWS OVERSEAS impex.

items.question: Does it have to be a shipment specifically?
items.answer: No. Any completed purchase counts — a freight shipment, a product order from our catalog, or any paid service. And it's not a one-time thing: every qualifying order from your referral pays out another $25, not just their first.

items.question: Is there a limit to how much I can earn?
items.answer: No cap. Refer as many people as you want — each one who completes a qualifying order earns you another $25.

items.question: Where do I find my referral code?
items.answer: Sign in and open your profile — your unique code and referral activity are on your account dashboard.

items.question: When does the reward get credited?
items.answer: As soon as your referral's order is confirmed and paid, $25 is credited to your AWS OVERSEAS impex wallet automatically.

items.question: Can I use my own referral code?
items.answer: No — referral rewards are for bringing new customers to AWS OVERSEAS impex, not for orders on your own account.

homeSection.title: Refer a shipper. Earn $25.
homeSection.description: Know someone who imports, exports, or ships freight? Send them your code. Every shipment they complete after that puts $25 in your wallet.
